The original rt() component and descendants are untouched. Original React71645/ReactDOM88014/store4421/Turbopack runtime and frozen lazy chunks execute from an ephemeral localhost server. The private rt() bypasses the public authentication/bootstrap wrapper and uses synthetic store state.

No keyboard was opened, no calls/recording/files were sent, no user/server/account settings were written.

ordinaryIncomingMessagePolicy: Ignore own author, site-ban/blocked author, unknown channel, thread channel, closed server and disallowed server takedown state.

DM requires unmuted channel. Server requires a qualifying mention/all-notify result and server not muted, and the upstream suppression argument is false.
Channel notification-level none suppresses sound even if direct mention remains counted; all respects mute settings. Mention qualification uses the original mention/role/here/reply policy helpers.
Per(channel_id,author_id) throttle5s; deduplicate message ID across tabs with120s persisted window, BroadcastChannel and navigator locks.
Audio helper additionally throttles120ms; message gain defaults0.9. If sample playback fails, original synthesizes a short two-tone fallback.
